changelog:
本次更新修了亿个Bug，兼容了许多角色卡，增加了前端兼容性

欢迎加入软件反馈/RP欢乐QQ交流群1129035651，新群欢迎来聊天，反馈问题可以更快回复

修复了：
1. 软件公告烦人频率的问题
2. 每次导入角色卡多导入一个默认助手的bug
3. 打开输入法后屏幕尺寸发生变化导致的前端卡乱跳
4. 世界书启用/未启用显示失灵
5. 部分卡片表格无法显示的问题
6. 部分卡片转码失败的问题
7. 软件无法压缩的问题
8. 无法关闭深度思考的问题
9. 上下文滚动压缩失效的问题

增添了：
1. 世界书内部显示，更方便的看到世界书条目
2. 导演备注多选（感谢 shark12bee 的 PR#8）
3. 兼容风月AI酒馆卡格式
4. 兼容春水AI酒馆卡格式
5. 兼容一些不知名AI站点的酒馆卡格式

────────────

This release fixes a huge number of bugs, adds compatibility with many character cards, and improves frontend card support.

Welcome to the feedback / RP QQ group 1129035651 — new members are always welcome, and bug reports get faster replies there.

Fixed:
1. Announcement appearing too often
2. An extra default assistant being created on every card import
3. Frontend cards jumping around when the keyboard changed the screen size
4. World book enable/disable toggles not showing correctly

Added:
1. World book entry list view, so entries are easier to see
2. Multiple Author's Notes (thanks to shark12bee's PR#8)
3. Compatibility with Fengyue AI tavern cards
4. Compatibility with Chunshui AI tavern cards
5. Compatibility with tavern cards from various lesser-known AI sites

Also fixed: tables in some cards not rendering, encoding failures on some cards, context compression failing, the reasoning toggle not turning off deep thinking, and rolling context compression not working.
